user.description: Configure the Green Button integration by pasting an ESPI (Green Button) Atom XML export. The XML must contain exactly one UsagePoint.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this usage point (for example, your home or a specific meter).
data_description.xml: The contents of the Green Button / ESPI Atom XML export downloaded from your utility.

error.no_usage_points_found: No UsagePoints found in the XML. You need exactly one.
error.multiple_usage_points_found: Multiple UsagePoints found in the XML. You need exactly one.

import_espi_xml.name: Import ESPI XML
import_espi_xml.description: Imports usage data from an XML string containing the ESPI Atom format.

delete_statistics.name: Delete statistics
delete_statistics.description: Deletes a Green Button long-term statistic.

statistic_id.name: Statistic ID
statistic_id.description: The ID of the statistic to clear. Must start with `green_button:`.

log_statistics.name: Log statistics
log_statistics.description: Logs the recorded statistics for the selected entities over a time range (diagnostic).

start.name: Start
start.description: The start of the time range to log.

end.name: End
end.description: The end of the time range to log.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Resets the selected entities and clears their long-term statistics.
